verdict.rationale: Docs confirm a policy template library that can be customized (docs-11) and a draft/publish workflow implying review and approval steps (docs-12/26/36), but there is no explicit mention of version history, per-employee acceptance/e-sign tracking, or any 'lawyer-grade' sourcing of the templates. Missing for 10: explicit versioning of policies, per-employee acceptance tracking/attestation workflow, and evidence of lawyer-reviewed template quality.
